reason: The permitted Stage-2 raw-extension contract only says that the closed datum admits some map v_+:M_{r+1}->A_R with the D_2 t isomorphism and unit bounds. It never identifies that existential v_+ with the exact raw-call datum's already recorded literal output map u_2. Under def-maincb-raw-call, the literal output map is a field of the datum, and a recorded raw-call datum alone asserts no success property. Thus the inference silently replaces u_2 by v_+ and does not prove that the literal u_2 has either asserted bound; an equality/selection clause tying u_2:=v_+ (or a provider conclusion stated for the literal map) is required.
